name: 85248 · Chandler, AZ
findings: ZIP 85248 (Chandler) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85248 (Chandler) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85248 (Chandler) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).
